feedback: Good improvement from the previous review: the collections Lot du mois now reads as an intentional floating overlap, and the journal/commander tablet layouts no longer show the earlier page-wide horizontal overflow. The site remains a strong match for the French minimalist artisan stationery brief, with the required pages, tactile imagery, warm palette, serif editorial typography, bottom tabs, asymmetry, configurator, journal, contact content, and expected intentional defects visible. Remaining issue: the fixed bottom navigation still sits over important content in multiple first-screen views, including the accueil collection card, journal featured title, commander swatches, and contact message field. Add viewport-aware spacing or reposition those sections so the required fixed nav does not obscure copy or controls.
